alignments.note: Article on the substantive recast as 'They that ...'; the supplied pronoun and relative stand where the article's 'the' would stand (rule 41 reasoning), headed on the pronoun. Competing reading: article unrepresented and 'They that' joined to the noun under rule 46's nominal-recasting sentence.
Rephaim rendered 'are deceased' with the construction copula (rule 20); margin 'The shades / The Rephaim' read and set aside (rule 38).

מִתַּחַת → 'Beneath' fuses under rule 30 (one English word for the pair). Both tokens are tagged R, so this is rule 23's compound preposition written from two prepositions, headed on the first, governing morpheme (מִן), exactly as מֵעַל → 'from'/'against' heads on מִן whatever the English word. Competing reading: head on תַּחַת read as a construct noun, which MACULA's tag does not support here.
Anarthrous participle rendered as a noun phrase with supplied 'the' (rule 46).

review_notes: Only the source head of the מִתַּחַת → 'Beneath' unit changed: rule 23 heads a two-preposition compound on its first morpheme; the previous note called תַּחַת a construct noun, but it is tagged R.
